title: Remap keyboard shortcut does not work with Notion

status.label: Retest the Notion shortcut failure on current stable
status.detail: On PowerToys 0.95.0, remapping Notion's Ctrl+Shift+E to Ctrl+E reportedly breaks all Ctrl-based shortcuts in Notion until PowerToys restarts.

judgment.rationale: The reporter lists PowerToys 0.95.0 and says remapping Notion's Ctrl+Shift+E to Ctrl+E makes the remapping and other Ctrl shortcuts stop working in Notion until PowerToys restarts; they report the problem across several Notion versions. A related closed report #43302 describes intermittent shortcut interception failures, but it does not establish the same Notion-specific trigger or a covering fix. Ask for the current Notion/PowerToys versions and whether restarting Keyboard Manager still restores the shortcuts before choosing an investigation path.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.95.0 installed through WinGet and Notion as the affected application.
The example remap is Ctrl+Shift+E to Ctrl+E.
The reporter says all remappings and original Ctrl shortcuts stop working in Notion until PowerToys restarts.
The reporter says this has happened across several Notion versions and has never worked as expected.
There are no comments or assignees; closed #43302 is a broader intermittent interception report, not a confirmed duplicate.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the Notion shortcut failure persists on v0.102.3001, provide the Notion version, and confirm whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores shortcuts.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported Notion-specific failure is from PowerToys 0.95.0 and lacks current-version confirmation; the related general interception report does not establish the same defect.

issue_context.summary: Remapping Notion's Ctrl+Shift+E to Ctrl+E reportedly disables other Ctrl shortcuts in Notion until PowerToys restarts.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.95.0 installed through WinGet.
The affected app is Notion; the example remap is Ctrl+Shift+E to Ctrl+E.
The reporter says original and remapped Ctrl shortcuts stop working in Notion until PowerToys restarts.
No public follow-up or assignee is present.
inferences: The issue may involve how Notion processes injected shortcut events or a Keyboard Manager interception state, but no current trace or reproduction confirms the mechanism.
issue_context.analysis: The report is Notion-specific and suggests a broader Ctrl-shortcut failure after a remap. A current retest and recovery result are needed; do not infer a root cause from the separate general interception report #43302.
initial_investigation: Read the issue body, labels, and assignees; there are no comments.
Compared the report with closed #43302, which describes intermittent interception failures but does not establish the same app-specific behavior.

information_gaps.information: Whether Ctrl+Shift+E to Ctrl+E and other Ctrl shortcuts still fail in Notion on v0.102.3001, the Notion version, and whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores them
information_gaps.why_needed: The report is from PowerToys 0.95.0 and does not identify the Notion version; current behavior and recovery distinguish an active product issue from an app/version-specific interaction.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On v0.102.3001, test the listed remap and another Ctrl shortcut in Notion; report the Notion version and whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores the original and remapped shortcuts.

actions.label: Retest the Notion shortcut failure on current stable

comment.body: Thanks for the Ctrl+Shift+E-to-Ctrl+E example and for noting that other Ctrl shortcuts also stop working in Notion. Since the report is from PowerToys 0.95.0, could you retest on v0.102.3001, include your Notion version, and say whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores the shortcuts?
